interfaces_or_endpoints: Provider-neutral bounded LanguageModel interface makes one prompt-guided attendance-intent selection, then receives the successful raw result only after bot-owned authenticated execution and returns a validated ordered Teams Markdown batch

One-shot authenticated MCP 1.3.0 discovery retains the bounded read-only allowlist and admits bot-owned self, exact-selector other-attendance, and required statuses-array current-status policies; display-name search is not an admitted action

Authenticated Teams personal-chat flow splits self and other history up to twelve calendar months into inclusive 31-day windows, caps a request at 200 events with disclosure metadata, pages current status to exhaustion, and prevents further model tool selection after the validated action

Two-stage LLM routing makes a pre-auth guidance decision from bot-owned read-only action definitions and an unverified presentation-only Teams display name; safe greeting, clarification, and attendance-only scope guidance end with zero SSO/OBO/MCP/REST activity, while a validated selection enters the existing single SSO/OBO and live MCP catalog admission path

TEAMS-TOOL-BOUNDARY-ROUTING: the pre-auth LLM prompt resolves calendar-language requests (including whole-year, last-months, and since-month forms) and contextual current-presence status sets. The bot validates and executes one discovery-admitted action, then supplies its raw successful result to the LLM for a validated ordered message batch. Replies reject internal IDs, notes, locations, unsafe Markdown, and malformed batches; Teams delivery stops on the first failed send. REST v1 and MCP 1.3.0 remain unchanged.
